## Description

Convert news, filings or text into sentiment/event features and trade securities with positive or negative information signals.

## Where it may fit

Information-driven markets where text arrives before prices fully adjust and the data feed is timely.

## Vehicles

Event-driven equity funds, systematic stock-selection, FX/macro research.

## Required data

Timestamped news/filings, entity mapping, text model, sentiment labels, release times, market data and license/cost information.

## Caveats

Publication timestamps, duplicated stories, model drift and survivorship in news archives can create hidden look-ahead.
